description: This file defines the LocalizationService class that provides methods for managing localization, including language and translation management, validation of localization files, and exporting language packages. It interacts with DAO and external services to handle internationalization data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Service class providing localization management functionalities such as language handling, translation management, validation, and exporting within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocalizationDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LocalizationDao.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the container.

methods.name: getLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Returns an array of supported date formats with examples based on current date.

methods.name: getSupportedDateFormats
methods.description: Provides an array of all supported date format patterns and their labels.

methods.name: getCurrentDateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the default date format configured in the system.

methods.name: getSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Fetches the list of enabled and added languages.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages matching specific filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesArray
methods.description: Normalizes and returns an array of language models.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves or updates translated language strings from provided rows.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves import error language strings for a specific language and employee.

methods.name: createTranslatedItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates translation entities from raw input rows.

methods.name: createImportErrorItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates import error entities from raw input rows.

methods.name: generateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for language string identifiers.

methods.name: exportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Exports language data into an XLIFF package.

methods.name: getXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Creates DOM XML representing the XLIFF export for translation groups.

methods.name: getTargetLanguageFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the target language code from an XLIFF DOMDocument.

methods.name: validateTargetString
methods.description: Validates the target string syntax and placeholders against source string.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NError entity by its name.

methods.name: processXliffFile
methods.description: Validates and processes an uploaded XLIFF translation file.

methods.name: validateXliffFile
methods.description: Checks the syntax, schema, and target language of an XLIFF file.

methods.name: validateLangStrings
methods.description: Validates language strings within an XLIFF file, categorizing valid, invalid, and skipped strings.

methods.name: languageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if a language has import errors for a specific employee.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Removes import error records for given language strings.
